fields.summary_ko.0: Saudi Aramco's Riyadh office was attacked on Sunday, causing shrapnel damage to administrative buildings; the Energy Ministry and Saudi telecom company confirmed no casualties.
fields.summary_ko.1: Aramco employees at the King Abdullah Financial District, a major Riyadh hub, have maintained remote work status over the past month, with this incident suggesting potential further work postponement.
fields.summary_ko.2: Recent repeated attacks by Houthi militants have targeted Aramco headquarters, Shaybah oil field, and other major assets including Ras Tanura field and the East-West pipeline are facing threats.
